SessionStart.command: for n in /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node node; do command -v "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$n" ./scripts/agy-hook.mjs session-start; done

hooks.command: for n in /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node node; do command -v "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$n" ./scripts/agy-hook.mjs pre-tool-use; done

Stop.command: for n in /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node node; do command -v "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$n" ./scripts/agy-hook.mjs stop; done
